threshold_basis: Prediction/likelihood gates retained from prior milestones. Residual tolerance is prediction absolute tolerance divided by nominal1e-4 error. New solver parameter gates are predeclared small fractions (~1e-5) of parameter intervals, not posterior uncertainties; minimum chi² gate is negligible relative to order-unity changes. No existing tolerance was relaxed.

timing_conditions.hardware_window: Same checkpointed window/process CPU/GPU comparison: affinity0-15, Nice10, BLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR threads1, MCMC process count1. Callback includes parameter transforms/constraints, actual BinarySystem construction, fresh physical model/transfers/mapping/normalization and final existing likelihood/prior. First callback and object/observation setup separate. Least-squares and sampler times include new fitter construction, actual original fit() setup, physical calls, compilation incurred and serialization. Runtime may be warm from earlier correctness gates. Three warm callback samples; fit/sampler single bounded runs, not throughput/convergence studies.
timing_conditions.cpu_development: Production running; forced JAX CPU, affinity16-19, Nice19, thread counts1. Not a matched timing profile to hardware window; only correctness and supplementary cost evidence.

unsupported_policy: Experimental fitting adapter always runs full unmodified CPU Observer for unsupported device model/backend/resource states. GPU unavailability/disabled FP64 is an error, not a physical prior. Test q0.4 returns finite original posterior even with emergency exception penalties enabled. CPU default classes/backends unchanged.
sampling_accuracy: The deliberately coarse12-threshold uniform and equal-length manual supports have up to0.10 normalized-flux error against direct original CPU predictions. This is original time/interpolation discretization error, not GPU numerical error, and these supports are branch coverage fixtures rather than scientific fitting recommendations. The representative public fits/sampler use direct synthesis.
assessment: Validated opt-in serial hybrid physical fit callbacks and actual public fit lifecycles. Warm GPU likelihood is slightly slower than original CPU in this workload; compilation makes bounded full fits and short chains slower. No production default integration, convergence, ESS/sec or physical-posterior precision claim.
